title: Bane of Illagers Enchantment
description: Adds the new Bane of Illagers enchantment! Deal more damage to Raid Mobs
body:
## 📖 Description

Adds an Enchantment that makes you deal more damage to raid mobs! Useful for not one-hit raid farms, and overall fighting raids!

## ⭐ Ways of Obtaining

You can obtain this enchantment from Villager Trades and Enchanting Tables.
Loot table will be added for Woodland Mansions later,



## ⌨️ Commands
Enchant:

/enchant @s improvedenchants:bane_of_illagers
